scripts.build: node tools/run-check.mjs build pnpm exec nx run-many -t build --all
scripts.check: node tools/run-check.mjs check pnpm run check:workspace
scripts.check:workspace: pnpm run format:check && pnpm exec nx run-many -t typecheck --all && pnpm exec eslint apps packages tools && node tools/check-boundaries.mjs && pnpm migration:check
scripts.test:unit: node tools/run-check.mjs unit pnpm run test:unit:workspace
scripts.test:unit:workspace: pnpm exec nx run-many -t build --all && pnpm exec vitest run --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:integration: node tools/run-check.mjs integration pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:e2e: node tools/run-check.mjs e2e pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.accessibility:check: pnpm exec playwright test apps/web/e2e/foundation.spec.ts --grep "has no automated WCAG 2.2 AA violation"
scripts.migrate: pnpm --filter @docket/database build && pnpm --filter @docket/migrate build && node apps/migrate/dist/index.js
